// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/live-policy-status-filter.test.ts.
// The other half of the bug class: an ownership SET query with no status
// filter at all, so soft-deleted / cancelled / still-analyzing rows count as
// "policies this person has". Both the direct and the relation form.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function probeUnfilteredOwnership(userId: string) {
    // Direct: counts every stored row as a held policy.
    const policyCount = await db.policy.count({
        where: { ownerUserId: userId },
    })

    // Relation: gaps on non-live policies counted against a live portfolio.
    const gapCount = await db.gapInstance.count({
        where: {
            policy: { ownerUserId: userId },
            status: { in: ["open", "detected"] },
        },
    })

    return { policyCount, gapCount }
}
